description.value:
Using a hologram emitter, you alter your projected appearance until you dismiss the power or it ends: you can appear up to a foot taller or shorter and change your apparent build, though your basic body structure stays the same, and the disguise extends to your worn and carried gear.

Since the effect is purely visual, touch reveals your true form. A creature can also see through the illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your tech save DC.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
